info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens OpenAI Chat API

items.docs: Chat with a language model. This endpoint is consistent with the [OpenAI Chat Completions API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat) and may be used with the OpenAI JS or Python SDK by setting the base URL to `https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/openai`.

This endpoint returns a list of Open Source and OpenAI models that are available for use.

**Note**: Model `id`'s will be in the form `{source}/{model_name}`. For example `openai/gpt-4` or `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1` consistent with HuggingFace naming conventions.
